parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh_cn**. Valid values:

- **zh_cn**: Chinese (Simplified).
- **en_us**: English (US).

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The search keyword. Fuzzy match is supported. For example, if you enter data, all data entries that contain data in the search item are returned.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of data asset instances to return on each page in a paged query. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description: The name of the product to which the data asset instance belongs, such as MaxCompute, OSS, or RDS. For supported product names, see [Data types from which sensitive data can be detected](~~212906~~).

parameters.name: ProductId
parameters.description: The ID of the product to which the data asset instance belongs. You can call the [DescribeDataAssets](~~DescribeDataAssets~~) operation to obtain the product ID.

parameters.name: RiskLevelId
parameters.description:
The risk level ID of the data asset instance. A higher risk level ID indicates more sensitive data is detected. Valid values:

- **1**: No sensitive data is detected. No risk.
- **2**: Sensitive data risk at level 1.
- **3**: Sensitive data risk at level 2.
- **4**: Sensitive data risk at level 3.
- **5**: Sensitive data risk at level 4.
- **6**: Sensitive data risk at level 5.
- **7**: Sensitive data risk at level 6.
- **8**: Sensitive data risk at level 7.
- **9**: Sensitive data risk at level 8.
- **10**: Sensitive data risk at level 9.
- **11**: Sensitive data risk at level 10.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the sensitive data detection rule that the data asset instance hits. You can call the [DescribeRules](~~DescribeRules~~) operation and obtain the rule ID from the **Id** response parameter.

parameters.name: ServiceRegionId
parameters.description: The region of the data asset instance. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~214257~~).
